trickyParts: Exactness of the splice rests on the guards in pmdoc/layout.go: no cross-block renderer state may carry into the next block, the footnote label set and other-list-marker classes must be unchanged, and the span budget must never reach 0.
ygo's ChangedTypes includes types the transaction created or deleted; the walk up Parent is bounded by pmdoc.MaxTreeDepth so a deep chain renders whole instead of costing depth per changed type.
